description: rnews_main.rs:147-177: core_pool and transit_pool are wrapped in Arc<AnyPool>, then immediately deref-cloned with (*core_pool).clone() at lines 176-177. AnyPool (sqlx) is itself an internally ref-counted pool handle — cloning it is O(1) and does not copy connection state. The outer Arc<T> provides no benefit and forces the awkward (*pool).clone() pattern. Idiomatic fix: drop Arc::new(...) wrappers; let core_pool: AnyPool = ...; let transit_pool: AnyPool = ...; then MsgIdMap::new(core_pool.clone()) and SqliteLogStorage::new(core_pool.clone()) just call .clone() on the pool directly. The Arc overhead also adds two extra ref-count increments on every use via Deref.
title: rnews_main: Arc<AnyPool> is redundant — AnyPool is already ref-counted
